title: Managed transaction callback refused (BEGIN not supported); auto-commit unaffected

driver_failure.message: Failed after retried for 2 times in 1000 ms. Make sure that your database is online and retry again.

notes: With a 1s transaction retry bound the driver exhausts its retries quickly; each BEGIN attempt is refused at the decode boundary (finding B5-B-IMPL-F01) and never reaches RUN.
